description: Transliterate Cyrillic text into Latin using a named standard: ISO 9:1995 (one-to-one, with diacritics, covering the full standard: Russian, other Slavic, historic and non-Slavic Cyrillic letters) or BGN/PCGN, which is the Russian system only (Ukrainian, Serbian and other letters are passed through unmapped). Returns the transliteration, the source script, the standard, the mapped fraction and the unmapped characters. Other scripts are rejected with UNSUPPORTED_VALUE. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

case.description: preserve (default), lower or upper. Accepted: preserve, lower, upper.

from.description: Source script name (cyrillic), or auto (default). Accepted: cyrillic or auto.

standard.description: Romanisation standard: iso-9 (default; all ISO 9:1995 Cyrillic letters) or bgn-pcgn (BGN/PCGN Russian system, Russian letters only). Accepted: iso-9 or bgn-pcgn (Russian letters only) for cyrillic.

text.description: Text to transliterate, at most 2048 characters. Accepted: at most 2048 characters.

name: text_transliterate
title: Cyrillic-to-Latin transliteration (ISO 9:1995, BGN/PCGN Russian)
